reviews.text: Terrible experience, don't take your dogs there. They fractured my friend's puppy's femur when she was only 4 months old. She had been to a groomer before. Don't risk it. Awful service.
They refuse to provide care and support after an attack by one of the dogs they care for there. They neither respond nor cooperate in finding a solution for the victim.

I had a very good experience with Inteligencia Canina in Mexico City. From the beginning, it's clear that it's a place very focused on the well-being of dogs and on truly helping improve their behavior and coexistence. I felt very confident seeing that they offer training, school, daycare, and boarding services, and that they have experience working with dogs of different ages and needs.

What I liked most is that it doesn't feel like a makeshift place, but rather a specialized space where they truly understand how to work with dogs and also how to guide owners. It's clear they have a long history in this type of service and a very comprehensive offering, including in-home training and programs for different stages.

Furthermore, I find it very valuable that their approach is described as free of punishment and mistreatment, using tools like positive reinforcement. That makes a big difference, because ultimately, you're looking for a place where they don't just "obey" the dog, but where they truly treat it well and work professionally.

It's also reassuring to know they have several branches in Mexico City and the State of Mexico, which speaks to a well-established and trustworthy operation for many people seeking support for their pets.

Overall, it left a very good impression on me. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a serious, professional place focused on the well-being of their dogs. Excellent service, a well-structured service plan, and an excellent option for dog training and care.

I was very pleased with the excellent care my dog ​​received. He's very wary, but thanks to their work and techniques, he settled in very well with the pack. The staff's treatment of me was outstanding.

Hi, in our case, whenever we need boarding services for our dog (Billy), they always attend to us quickly and with the confidence that he's well cared for while we're away, and with excellent communication. We always go to the Eugenia branch without any problems.

I took my husky there for 3 months and everything was great. The staff there are very nice and you can tell they love animals; they don't just see it as a job, they give them love and dedication. They also always kept me informed and sent me pictures of my dog.
